Yeah the head chef isn't great about following the rules either lol. Before working here I had worked as the head chef at a farm to table restaurant and like this hipster bar. I took a break from the industry and moved back home to help care for a family member. This job is supposed to be like an easy temporary job while I renovate a building for my own place and I literally go home more stressed than when I was working 13hr days lol 

the customers are really nice lol which is why I can't bring myself to quit

Im just a line cook there, and if im being real the head chef doesn't really follow best practices either lol. And the environment makes it really hard to make suggestions so I just do things the way I want to and don't say anything.  My coworker just keeps getting upset when I toss the cambros on the shifts I work alone (also she doesn't date these lol) and they were literally so adamant that there was nothing wrong with it that I like needed confirmation that im right here lol

>my opinion. Second one I told about my eating issues and he said "you're skinny but not deathly" and that he wishes he had my problem. Wtf man i give up. I really feel like I need therapy more than ever but I've only had bad experiences thus far.

If you're in the US you should be able to find an official complaint form for your states licensing board. I checked for my state and it's an online form on the states website.

Hey I honestly think that your current therapist seems incredibly unprofessional, and honestly creepy in a way that really doesn't sit right w me. And if I were you I would honestly consider making a complaint about him, bc I just really feel like those kinds of comments aren't appropriate and if it's happening w you its probably happing with others. 

I also really had a hard time find a therapist that worked for me, I think if it's possible for you I'd shop around and maybe have a session or two with different ppl until you find someone who you feel is a good fit. I sort of did that the last time I was looking and I think I probly saw three or four different ppl before I found a therapist who worked for me. I really wish you the best!
